Geographies Served Programs Life Skills, Sexual Health & Girls' Rights with Enfold District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Enfold, our enduring partner organization, conducts an annual program centered on three key themes: life skills, sexual health, and girls' rights. Through engaging sessions, girls are equipped with a variety of skills aimed at enhancing their understanding of their rights and their bodies as they transition into independent young women. Additionally, regular sessions cover topics such as menstrual and sexual health. Career Counselling with iDream District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Girls participated in the annual career guidance program, where they underwent assessments to gauge their aptitude and interests. They also engaged in group career sessions and received one-on-one counseling. This year, guided by expert counselors and their own interests, the 10th grade girls chose to pursue Commerce-CEBA and Arts. fields.description: The Baale Mane, a home for disadvantaged or abandoned girls in Bangalore, India. Dedicated to enabling disadvantaged girls to lead self sustaining adult lives. Committed to Child Rights in accordance with the UN Charter of Child Rights and focused on Women
